# Astra: Organizational Context and Structured Performance Plan

Astra is suitable for organizing tasks, generating plans, and analyzing issues based on operation reports before performance. Real-time key presses are executed by the local controller.

## Offline Preparation

The context tool in this chapter uses the standard library to generate requests and example plans first:

```bash
python piano_context.py prepare --out runs/context
python piano_context.py verify --plan example.plan.json
```

Input includes [task.json](../../../../06-策略抓取或抓取VLA/大模型控制、VLA、VLM/20-GPT6-Astra机器人弹琴与上下文工程/task.json), [plan.schema.json](../../../../06-策略抓取或抓取VLA/大模型控制、VLA、VLM/20-GPT6-Astra机器人弹琴与上下文工程/plan.schema.json), and example plans. `--image` can be used to add scene screenshots. `--feedback` receives a JSON array, and each record may contain `time_seconds`, `expected_midi`, `observed_midi`, `outcome`, and `error`; it cannot directly input a full object format performance report.

## Optional online invocation

`piano_context.py online --run runs/context` will initiate real API requests and incur costs. Set your credentials before calling it. The request model name for the script is `gpt-6-astra`; please ensure that the endpoint used is accessible to this model, and do not treat desktop client subscriptions as API permissions.

For online invocation, you need to install the `openai` Python package separately and set `OPENAI_API_KEY`. When using a self-owned compatible endpoint, set `OPENAI_BASE_URL` according to its instructions. The key is not stored in the repository; for parsing results, see [piano_context.py](../../../../06-策略抓取或抓取VLA/大模型控制、VLA、VLM/20-GPT6-Astra机器人弹琴与上下文工程/piano_context.py). The sample provided in this chapter can run offline, and model integration is not a prerequisite for starting simulation.

The generated plan must pass checks for fields, time, instructions, and reachability ranges before running the simulation. The melody of the track shall be based on the sheet music provided by the user or authorized, and the model should not guess notes based on the song title.

## Three-layer Collaboration

- Astra: Prepare the context and candidate plans, and read the runtime feedback.
- G0.5: Provide the two-arm adjustment proposal based on actual observations.
- Local playing controller: Execute double-finger techniques, chords, key contact, and audio generation.

The current open-source main process can directly read the prepared JSON exercises, without the need to call Astra online.
